prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create byar-e.png, a production animation sprite sheet for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0. Use attached Image 1 as the LOCKED character design reference, faithfully matching its face, hair, outfit, equipment and ink/cel painting style.
Canvas exactly 1536x1024 landscape, real transparent alpha background. Exactly EIGHT full-body drawings in TWO rows of FOUR, reading left to right. Each occupies its own 384x512 cell, with clear transparent gaps, no overlap or cropping. Equal character proportions and scale throughout (scaled consistently from reference to fit the sheet). Boots on a shared baseline near y=490 for top row and y=1005 for bottom row. Allow room for raised weapons. All eight face LEFT in profile/slight 3/4. No text, numbers, borders, ground, shadows, dust, motion lines, or scenery.
Character: Jaret Byar, tall gaunt hard man about 40, long bony face hollow cheeks, deep-set dark burning eyes, thin mouth, close-cropped dark hair grey temples, NO helmet. Match reference exactly: mud-stained ragged long WHITE cloak and white tabard, golden SUNBURST left breast with TWO golden rank knots below; steel breastplate, pauldrons, grey mail sleeves, steel gauntlets and greaves, brown boots. Left arm bears the reference's large white kite shield with identical golden sunburst and gilded rim. Right-hand longsword has the reference's identical long straight steel blade and gilded crossguard. Keep shield and sword size/shape consistent in every pose.
Style: hand-drawn HD 2D fighting-game art, Streets of Rage 4 spirit, confident near-black/dark brown outlines thick outside thin inside, clean 2-3 tone cel shading and subtle painterly gradients, soft upper-left light and gentle cool right rim, grounded rich colors. Not pixel art, 3D, photo, or chibi. Exactly two arms two legs two booted feet, anatomically correct five-finger hands.
Eight genuinely distinct sequential drawings:
TOP ROW:
1 GRAB: right arm reaching up and back, gripping short wooden torch with bright orange flame atop. Sword fully sheathed in plain white-and-steel scabbard at LEFT hip. Shield on left arm.
2 RAISE: right hand holds SAME torch high above head, blazing flame, furious face; sword sheathed, shield on left arm.
3 WIND-UP: torch arm drawn far back behind him to the RIGHT, torso twisted, preparing to throw LEFT; same torch and scabbard, sword sheathed, shield on left.
4 THROW: right arm whips forward LEFT, open right fingers; flaming torch airborne just past fingertips to LEFT. Sword sheathed, shield on left arm.
BOTTOM ROW:
5 FOLLOW-THROUGH: right arm extended forward and down LEFT, hand EMPTY, leaning forward. NO torch visible. Sword sheathed in same left-hip scabbard; shield on left.
6 DRAW: right hand grips gilded sword hilt and pulls longsword partially out of same LEFT-hip white-and-steel scabbard; NO torch. Shield on left arm.
7 STANDING ACCUSATION: upright tall theatrical villain pose, longsword fully drawn in RIGHT hand pointing diagonally up and forward LEFT, shouting expression, shield on LEFT arm, empty scabbard at left hip. NO torch.
8 COMMAND: sword held high overhead by RIGHT hand, shield pushed forward LEFT, mouth open in rallying cry (no written words), empty scabbard at left hip. NO torch.
Flame only on torches in frames 1-4. Kid-friendly no blood or gore. Generate all eight as different drawings, never repeats or mirrors. Actual transparent background with alpha, not checkerboard painted into the image.
